Kit summary

Interweaving AttackBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals 100% ATK [Bleed] DMG to an enemy and another 2 random enemies, with a 70% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. DMG dealt will be increased by 300% if there is only 1 enemy.
Staff of Demonic Seed Lv.3Parasitic Demonic Seed is enhanced. For every 50% Effect Hit owned by Morikis, additionally reduces all enemies' (excluding Boss) initial SPD by 1.6% (up to 8% of initial SPD can be reduced, cannot exceed 8% of Morikis's initial SPD), and increases self SPD and ATK by 40% of the enemies' corresponding attributes reduced in total. After Boss takes DMG from Interweaving Attack, Spirit of Exorcism, and Demonic Seed Wreathing, if [Bleed] owned by the boss reaches 1/5/10 layers, Morikis gains 1/3/5 layers of [Demonic Seed], each of which increases ATK by 4% and Mastery by 10%, up to 20 layers can be owned.
Spirit of ExorcismActiveExclusive Lv.3
Morikis summons 5 thorns to attack enemies randomly, each thorn deals 160% ATK [Bleed] DMG to 1 enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. If the same target is hit multiple times during a single cast of Spirit of Exorcism, the DMG taken each time equals 150% of the previous time; each enemy is calculated separately.
Staff of Demonic Seed Lv.3Parasitic Demonic Seed is enhanced. For every 50% Effect Hit owned by Morikis, additionally reduces all enemies' (excluding Boss) initial SPD by 1.6% (up to 8% of initial SPD can be reduced, cannot exceed 8% of Morikis's initial SPD), and increases self SPD and ATK by 40% of the enemies' corresponding attributes reduced in total. After Boss takes DMG from Interweaving Attack, Spirit of Exorcism, and Demonic Seed Wreathing, if [Bleed] owned by the boss reaches 1/5/10 layers, Morikis gains 1/3/5 layers of [Demonic Seed], each of which increases ATK by 4% and Mastery by 10%, up to 20 layers can be owned.
Parasitic Demonic SeedPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Morikis gains additional Mastery equal to 24% of self initial Effect Hit, up to 60% Mastery can be gained this way. At the beginning of each wave, for every 50% Effect Hit owned by Morikis, reduces all enemies' (excluding Boss) initial ATK by 2% (up to 10% of initial ATK can be reduced, cannot exceed 10% of Morikis's initial ATK), and increases self ATK by 20% of the enemies' initial ATK reduced in total.
Staff of Demonic Seed Lv.1At the beginning of each wave or self turns, Morikis gains [Stealth] for 1 turn. When receiving Fatal DMG, Morikis is immune to death until the skill attacked her ends, and restores her HP by 100% of Max HP after the skill ends. Meanwhile, cleanses [Freeze], [Stun], [Hypnotize], and [Imprison] from self. Afterward, acts for 1 turn immediately. The effects above can only be triggered once per wave. Besides, when Morikis is granted buffs from allies, for every 1 layer of buff gained, increases Morikis's Turn Meter by 4%. Each ally can grant Morikis 8% Turn Meter at most each turn in this way.
Staff of Demonic Seed Lv.3Parasitic Demonic Seed is enhanced. For every 50% Effect Hit owned by Morikis, additionally reduces all enemies' (excluding Boss) initial SPD by 1.6% (up to 8% of initial SPD can be reduced, cannot exceed 8% of Morikis's initial SPD), and increases self SPD and ATK by 40% of the enemies' corresponding attributes reduced in total. After Boss takes DMG from Interweaving Attack, Spirit of Exorcism, and Demonic Seed Wreathing, if [Bleed] owned by the boss reaches 1/5/10 layers, Morikis gains 1/3/5 layers of [Demonic Seed], each of which increases ATK by 4% and Mastery by 10%, up to 20 layers can be owned.
Demonic Seed WreathingActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Grants all allies [Bleed Up II] for 2 turns, with a 100% to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] on all enemies for 2 turns and a 100% chance to inflict [Severe Wound] on all enemies for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 200% ATK [Bleed] DMG to all enemies, for every 1 layer of [Bleed] owned by enemies, increases this DMG dealt by 10%, up to 60% can be increased.
Staff of Demonic Seed Lv.2Allies with the [Bleed] tag will gain extra ATK equal to 20% of Morikis's initial Effect Hit, up to 40% extra ATK can be gained this way. Besides, removes 1 layer of buff from each enemy before Demonic Seed Wreathing deals DMG.
Staff of Demonic Seed Lv.3Parasitic Demonic Seed is enhanced. For every 50% Effect Hit owned by Morikis, additionally reduces all enemies' (excluding Boss) initial SPD by 1.6% (up to 8% of initial SPD can be reduced, cannot exceed 8% of Morikis's initial SPD), and increases self SPD and ATK by 40% of the enemies' corresponding attributes reduced in total.
